title: See The Sony Airpeak S1 In Action On A Real-World Film Set
summary: A group of filmmakers put the Airpeak S1, with the Sony FX3 on board, to the test in a real-world shoot in the high desert.
body_markdown:
The[Airpeak S1](https://electronics.sony.com/more/airpeak/p/arss1) is Sony’s first professional drone and the world’s smallest drone that can be equipped with a wide range of Sony’s camera bodies. For a recent project, filmmakers Michael Dyrland of[DPdrones](https://www.dpdrones.com/) , Craig Coker and Eddie Hayes took the[Airpeak S1](https://electronics.sony.com/more/airpeak/p/arss1) and the[Sony FX3](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/cinema-line-cameras/all-cinema-line-cameras/p/ilmefx3) to Four Aces Movie Ranch in the desert northeast of Los Angeles. They used the combination to capture several unique film transitions, and you can see them in this special behind-the-scenes view in the video below. Watch to see how they were able to seamlessly transition the drone from filming outdoors to indoors, and learn more about the entire production at[sonycine.com](https://sonycine.com/articles/sony-airpeak-s1-and-fx3-put-to-the-test-in-the-desert/) .
